_source: Anthropic model catalog via the claude-api skill, checked 2026-08-04. Sonnet 5 list price; the $2/$10 introductory rate through 2026-08-31 is deliberately NOT used — a baseline built on a promo price silently regresses on 2026-09-01.
_multipliers_note: Cache tokens dominate input on every real run — the recorded probe has 4 raw input tokens against 71k cache tokens (tests/eval/fixtures/README.md). Pricing input+output alone undercounts a run ~26x. The two cache-write tiers are NOT interchangeable: Claude Code writes 1h entries on the main thread and 5m entries inside subagents, so a single multiplier on the aggregate is wrong for every case that delegates. Verified: with this split, the derived cost reproduces the CLI's own total_cost_usd exactly on both recorded fixtures.
_default_note: Used only when a turn names a model absent from `rates`. Set to the pack's top tier rather than a builder tier because understating cost is the worse failure for a cost instrument. Unknown models are never priced silently — eval-cost.py lists them under `unpriced_models`, and the reconciliation against the CLI's total_cost_usd drifts and says so.
